title: Mint in pots
text:
Mint spreads quickly through underground runners and can take over a shared planter within one season.
Grow mint in its own pot, at least 25 cm wide, rather than with other herbs.
Mint prefers moist soil and tolerates partial shade; 4 hours of sun a day is enough.
Harvest regularly by cutting stems back by a third; frequent cutting keeps the plant compact.
Mint goes dormant in cold weather in many climates and regrows from the roots in spring.
